articles.proposed_reference_transcription: Hamida Z, Goulet J-A. A stochastic model for estimating the network-scale deterioration and effect of interventions on bridges[J]. Structural Control and Health Monitoring, 2022, 29(4): e2916. DOI: 10.1002/stc.2916.
articles.safe_use_condition: Can cite for verified observation/state distinction, influence of missing interventions on estimates, and intervention-type/time/effect data needs. Metadata all corroborated from public author sources; publisher/Crossref edition not directly accessed. Do not imply support for current d,R or initial-state causal effects.

full_text_support.evidence: The SSM framework is extended from elements to bridges/network; handles missing data and interventions; demonstrated with individual cases with/without interventions and Quebec network of approximately7000bridges; estimates can help examine previous interventions and future maintenance.

Transition equation models latent deterioration and intervention-related state changes; observation equation adds inspector-associated Gaussian observation error. Latent condition, speed,acceleration and intervention-induced changes distinguished.
Intervention data explicitly characterised by type h_r, effect delta_r and time tau.

full_text_support.short_quote: assume there was no intervention, which ultimately can result into a bias in the model estimates towards underestimating the condition
full_text_support.evidence: Three missing-intervention scenarios: missing type, missing effect prior, unreported intervention; data/likelihood and averages by intervention type used for missing information.
Compares deterioration estimates when only reported interventions are used versus also accounting for potentially unreported interventions.

Intervention costs and expected improvements can differ by structural category and intervention type; framework quantifies deterioration from visual inspections and supports foundation for network planning.

recommended_replacement_sentences.4.1: 低频检测不仅减少可用样本，也使规划年份与最近实测年份之间出现时间间隔。Hamida和Goulet在状态空间模型中区分状态演化与检测误差，并将干预作用纳入估计；其缺失干预分析表明，忽略期间干预可能影响状态推断[23]。本文2024年仅有6个实测初值，其余53个评分由历史资料估计，规划初值不能等同同期实测状态；保留初值来源有助于明确后续复检需求。
recommended_replacement_sentences.4.2: 性能预测、不确定性与养护决策的联系已在桥梁网络养护优先级、年度预算约束下的状态预测与优化，以及概率性能预测规划等研究中讨论[3,14,16]。在本文给定递推及约束下，起始评分会影响接近阈值的时间与养护前评分排序，年度能力和累计资源约束进一步限制行动调整范围。这是对本文配对结果的模型内解释，尚不能推广为真实桥梁管理中的因果结论。
recommended_replacement_sentences.4.2_evidence_boundary: These references are already present with related scoped claims in the author’s introduction; no new abstract/fulltext retrieval for these3papers was possible. New wording repeats only broad study scope and clearly separates current model interpretation.
recommended_replacement_sentences.4.4: 本资料仅包括59个检测单元，216条测试记录属于既有单元的时间外验证，并非新桥梁外部验证；2024年53个估计初值没有同期真值。d未由真实退化过程校准，R=6未由真实养护事件校准，统一行动也不能代表不同工艺的响应。Hamida和Goulet的模型按干预类型、时间及效应描述干预信息，并讨论漏报事件对状态估计的影响[23]；本文进一步应用亦需结合真实养护事件与前后检测记录，检验评分变化关系及其不确定性。
recommended_replacement_sentences.numbering_note: [23] assumes the22existing references retain their present first-citation order and the new Hamida2022paper first appears in discussion4.1. Root should independently check final numbering.
